requirement_coverage.R07: G0 atomically commits cycle, allocation, context, admission, audit and outbox; concurrent reversed-order budgets serialize and insufficient capacity defers the existing intent without an orphan cycle.
requirement_coverage.R10: RunContext.local.v3 freezes allocation and reservation identities; current authority, baseline, goal, program, period and budget state are rechecked before new transfer or simulated dispatch.
requirement_coverage.R13: A genuine non-owner role uses narrow delegated subject/program/budget read locks without authority or budget UPDATE privilege; revocation blocks new transfer while canonical closure remains available.
requirement_coverage.R30: G1 moves bounds from G0 parents into canonical operation reservations without double counting; five ArchV4 cost categories, concurrent transfer, exact duplicate and late settlement are covered.
requirement_coverage.R31: Closure, cancellation, expiry, rollback and connection loss release only proven-unused amounts; dispatched or unknown liabilities remain until settlement and actual overage is recorded once.
requirement_coverage.R53: Additive migrations 0023-0025 preserve immutable allocation, operation, command, reservation and ledger identities; empty rollback/re-upgrade passes and populated V3 rollback refuses.
